title: v0.3.0 -- the release at which phase P2 (v0.3 Durable Program Runtime + Autonomy Contract Base) is closed

body_source.rule: The text of the GitHub release is the v0.3.0 section of RELEASE_NOTES.md at the tag, verbatim, from its heading to the separator before the v0.3.0a3 section -- the rule the three alphas used (their GitHub pre-release text was the section of their tag). CHANGELOG.md carries the section generated from the same notes.

distribution.note: The distribution workflow of this repository accepts only the audited v0.1.0; v0.3.0 is not published to PyPI.

readiness.note: A closed phase is not a stable release; readiness is not claimed by this release.

filled_at_the_tag.note: The tag step (the records procedure of the closure, step 16) fills these after the tag is cut; nothing in this file is a receipt of a publication. The v0.1.0 receipt beside this file has another schema and is untouched.
